chart.axis: 1pt x-baseline only (#E0E0E0 on white, #FFFFFF 30% on block), y-axis omitted
chart.value_label: 20pt Archivo ExtraBold, tabular figures, on bar end; key value also 80pt giant percent
chart.category_label: 13pt Archivo Bold under bar (#141414 white / #FFFFFF block)
chart.donut: uniform ring ~30% of radius, <=3 segments, center 80pt ExtraBold percent
chart.line: 3pt solid highlight (block color), 2pt #C9C9C9 compare, markers 8px endpoints, no area fill
chart.render: SVG precise, 0px corners, flat solid fill, no border box, no legend box, no shadow, no 3D

diagram.language: color block; 0px corners, flat solid fill, active node = slide block color rest #C9C9C9, no shadow/gradient
diagram.node: rectangular solid block, 2.3x1.0in, 0px radius, padding 0.22in; active block color rest #C9C9C9
diagram.step_badge: 0.5in square solid block (slide block color, 0px), Archivo ExtraBold 22pt #FFFFFF; inactive #C9C9C9
diagram.process: horizontal, <=5 steps, node gap 0.35in, 19pt Archivo Bold label, asymmetric
diagram.timeline: horizontal 3pt #141414 bar axis, 0.18in square markers (#C9C9C9, key = block color), <=6 markers
diagram.comparison: 2-3 full-height solid color block columns, 0px gap (color edge = divider), 38pt Bold #FFFFFF header, top-weighted
diagram.matrix: 4 solid quadrant blocks (3x #C9C9C9 + highlight block color, 1px white cross) or 4pt #141414 cross axes, square data points
diagram.hierarchy: 3-4 level stepped rect stack, solid fill, highlight 1 level block color rest #C9C9C9, 0.06in white gap
diagram.kpi_card: rectangular solid block (block color fill or white + 6px top color border), 80pt Archivo ExtraBold figure + 13pt Bold kicker + bold ▲/▼ delta
diagram.render: SVG precise, no div blocks, 0px corners, flat solid fill, no shadow

slide.transition: block slide-in 0.25s ease-out, travel <=15% canvas width; text instant
